design.name: 沙铁卫
design.brief: The bandit faction's hulking shield enforcer in Tang-dynasty Chinese heavy armour (明光铠): a huge inverted-triangle body with massive shoulders and arms and short legs, two round polished bronze chest mirror plates (护心镜), beast-head shoulder guards with a lion biting the arm (吞肩), layered bronze lamellar skirt over sand-coloured cloth, a small head inside a bronze suanni lion-dog helmet with a fanged mouth grille, glowing ember-orange eyes and a big red horsehair tassel (红缨) on top, the faction's crimson waist sash with the gold cloud-scroll emblem, cloud-pattern (云纹) and meander (回纹) borders on the armour edges, heavy cloth-wrapped shins and upturned Chinese armoured boots. Huge armoured gauntlets with a clearly separate thumb and four thick separate fingers.
design.weapon: a large round bronze shield with a fierce taotie (饕餮) mask in relief and a red-tasselled iron Chinese melon-head mace (骨朵)
